services.name: Party package
services.desc: YMCA Camp Sloper, with 143 acres of woods, fields, Sloper Pond, and other great program facilities, is the perfect place for your child to have a birthday celebration with friends. Parties are available for members and non-members. Bookings are accepted for Saturdays and Sundays in a two hour time frame at 3 different party times: 10am-12pm, 1pm-3pm, and 4pm-6pm. Parties are priced for up to 20 children, with a minimum of one adult chaperone required, and include the private use of a designated pavilion. services.name: Day Camp
services.desc: Since 1949, YMCA Camp Sloper has provided Day Camp for Southington and the surrounding towns each and every summer (even through pandemics!). As was the wish of Cornelia Sloper Neil, our goal will always be to provide age appropriate programming for youth in our communities that helps build healthy spirits, minds, and bodies. We offer programs from Pre-K all the way to sophomores in high school with both Traditional Camps as well as Specialty Camps that highlight specific interests. Our day camp runs four, 2-week long sessions for all age groups, minus our 1-week Pre-K program. In addition, we have two bookend weeks (Preview Week & Finale Week) that are 1-week traditional camp only

services.name: Facility Rentals
services.desc: The YMCA Camp Sloper Outdoor Center has large and small pavilions available for one-day group rentals throughout the year for graduation parties, corporate get-togethers, family reunions, DIY birthday celebrations, and any other private event! Rentals are available for members and non-members. Bookings are available on the weekends throughout the year, and in the evenings during the summer. All rentals include exclusive use of a selected pavilion, picnic tables, and a grill upon request. Bathroom and changing room facilities are also available. Groups can be from 10-200 or more people.
